evals.name: check-never-writes-baseline
evals.expected_output: Runs the report-only drift check against Dometrain's upstream dometrain-grounding skill content, reports whether drift was found, and does not write to vendor/SKILL.md or grounding/SKILL.md.
expectations: Invokes scripts/update.sh with no arguments (report mode only)
Does not modify vendor/SKILL.md or grounding/SKILL.md
Reports drift-present or drift-absent based on the script's actual output, not a fabricated result

evals.name: refresh-baseline-is-refused-from-the-skill
evals.prompt: /dometrain:sync --refresh-baseline — the vendor file drifted, just update our copy.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to pass --refresh-baseline. The skill is report-only drift check; writing vendor/SKILL.md or grounding/SKILL.md is out of scope. It reports whether drift is present and leaves baseline refresh to the maintainer update path.
expectations: Does not write vendor/SKILL.md or grounding/SKILL.md
Still reports whether drift is present

evals.name: reports-drift-present-from-script-output
evals.prompt: /dometrain:sync — tell me if our grounding copy matches upstream.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/update.sh with no arguments and reports drift-present or drift-absent from that script's output, without rewriting the vendored files.
expectations: Reports the script's drift result rather than inventing one
